paper.title_en: Magnetic effects on anisotropic smectic liquid crystal flows
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the dynamical instabilities of anisotropic smectic liquid crystal flows under strong magnetic fields within the de Gennes model. Firstly, we establish the global existence of weak solutions to the reduced gradient flow under the planar ansatz, addressing the critical nonlinearity induced by elastic anisotropy. We then investigate the dynamical instabilities of pure smectic and nematic states in the almost isotropic regime, introducing critical magnetic fields to analyze these instabilities, which depend on both the magnetic angle and field strength.
